# voucher-analysis

[![tests](https://github.com/CHANGPeijia-ACC/voucher-analysis/actions/workflows/tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/CHANGPeijia-ACC/voucher-analysis/actions/workflows/tests.yml)

A small journal entry testing (JET) toolkit: eleven rule-based tests over a full
year of journal entries, plus a bank reconciliation that matches a bank
statement to the books and produces a reconciliation statement.

**All data in this repository is synthetic.** It is generated by code in this
repository with a fixed random seed. It is not real company data, and the
company, supplier and customer names are invented.

Journal entry testing is a standard audit procedure. ISA 240 requires the
auditor to test the appropriateness of journal entries recorded in the general
ledger, because entries made outside normal business routines are a common way
to manipulate results.

## Why synthetic data

Real ledgers cannot be published. Synthetic data also makes it possible to
measure the tests: the generator injects a known list of anomalies and writes
them to `ground_truth.csv`, so every test can be scored on how much it finds
and how much it flags needlessly. On real data nobody knows the full answer.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
pip install -e .
```

Generate a data set (a copy is already committed in `data/sample`):

```bash
python -m voucher_analysis generate --out data/sample
```

Run the tests and the reconciliation:

```bash
python -m voucher_analysis run --gl data/sample/gl.csv --bank data/sample/bank.csv --config config.yaml --out outputs --ground-truth data/sample/ground_truth.csv
```

This writes `outputs/workpaper.xlsx` and prints a summary. On the sample data
it takes about 2.6 seconds. `--ground-truth` is optional: without it the
workbook has no Evaluation sheet, which is the normal case on real data.

All thresholds are in `config.yaml`. Nothing needs to be changed in the code to
use a different approval limit, close day, keyword list or country calendar.

## The data

`data/sample` holds one fiscal year (2025) built with seed 42.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `gl.csv` | 19,505 lines in 5,706 vouchers, 23 accounts, 26 suppliers, 5 preparers |
| `bank.csv` | 1,846 bank lines, with no voucher numbers |
| `ground_truth.csv` | 151 vouchers (2.6 percent) carrying one injected anomaly each |
| `bank_ground_truth.csv` | the expected match for every bank item |

Normal vouchers balance, are posted on Chinese working days, and are entered
during office hours before the period closes. Business includes purchase and
service invoices, monthly payment runs, sales with cost of sales, customer
receipts, payroll, depreciation, rent, utilities accruals and their reversals.

## The tests

Each test returns the lines it flags with the same columns: `test_id`,
`voucher_no`, `line_no`, `amount`, `reason`. Tests that judge a whole voucher
flag every line of it, so the reviewer sees the complete entry.

| Test | What it looks for | Audit risk |
|---|---|---|
| JET00 | Missing fields, bad voucher numbers, negative amounts, duplicate line keys | Data is incomplete, so the other tests cannot be relied on |
| JET01 | Total debit not equal to total credit | Entries that bypassed system controls |
| JET02 | Same account, supplier, side and amount within 7 days | Duplicate invoice, supplier paid twice |
| JET03 | Postings dated on weekends and public holidays | Entries made when no one is there to review them |
| JET04 | Entries made outside 08:00 to 20:00 | Unsupervised or shared-account activity |
| JET05 | Entries made after the period close deadline | Results adjusted after they were reported |
| JET06 | Round amounts at or above 10,000 | Estimates or invented amounts rather than real invoices |
| JET07 | Preparer is also the approver | Segregation of duties has failed, approval is not a control |
| JET08 | Several payments to one supplier just under the approval limit | Approval limits deliberately avoided |
| JET09 | Descriptions with words such as adjustment, reversal, 调整, 冲回, 暂估 | Manual corrections used to move results |
| JET10 | Amounts unusually large for their account | Overstated or unauthorised amounts |

JET05 also produces a month-end table: the share of vouchers and debit amount
posted in the last three days of each month. On the sample data that share runs
from 0.0 percent in January to 17.2 percent in October. Month-end work is
normal, so single entries are not flagged; a reviewer looks at the trend.

JET10 uses a robust z-score: `0.6745 * (value - median) / MAD`, where MAD is the
median absolute deviation. Median and MAD barely move when extreme values are
added, unlike mean and standard deviation, which the extreme value itself pulls
along. The score is computed on `log(amount)`, per account and per side (debit
or credit), and the bank account is excluded because one bank line can settle
many invoices that are already scored on their own accounts.

## Bank reconciliation

The bank statement carries no voucher numbers, as real statements do not. The
book side is one row per voucher: its net effect on the bank account. Amounts
are compared as whole cents, so no comparison depends on float equality.

1. **One to one**: equal amount within 3 days. When several bank lines have the
   same amount, the closest date wins. Nothing is matched twice.
2. **One to many**: one bank line equal to the sum of up to five vouchers for
   the same counterparty, for example a payment run settled in one transfer.
3. **Amount differences**: same counterparty and window, amounts differing by
   less than 2 percent, for example a transfer fee the bank deducted. These are
   not timing differences and have to be investigated.

What remains is classified as a deposit in transit (在途存款), an outstanding
payment (未兑付付款) or a bank-only item (银行单边), such as a bank charge or a
direct debit the books do not have yet. These are the reconciling items
(未达账项): neither side is wrong, the two sides recorded them at different times.

The statement adjusts each side for the items the other side already has, and
both adjusted balances must agree. On the sample data:

| | Amount |
|---|---|
| Balance per bank statement | 21,488,786.48 |
| Add: deposits in transit | 121,219.34 |
| Less: outstanding payments | -299,969.40 |
| **Adjusted bank balance** | **21,310,036.42** |
| Balance per general ledger | 21,339,027.49 |
| Add or less: bank items not yet booked | -28,916.07 |
| Add or less: amount differences per bank | -75.00 |
| **Adjusted book balance** | **21,310,036.42** |

Matching result on the sample year: 1,837 one to one, 3 one to many, 3 amount
differences, 12 outstanding payments, 2 deposits in transit and 3 bank-only
items. Every one of the 1,850 expected pairs in `bank_ground_truth.csv` is found
with the correct match type.

## Evaluation

Precision is the share of flagged vouchers that really carry an anomaly: it
says how much review time is spent on normal entries. Recall is the share of
injected anomalies that were found: it says how much is missed. Loosening a
threshold usually raises recall and lowers precision.

| Test | Injected | Flagged | Caught | False alarms | Missed | Precision | Recall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| JET01 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| JET02 | 16 | 14 | 14 | 0 | 2 | 1.000 | 0.875 |
| JET03 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| JET04 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| JET05 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| JET06 | 15 | 27 | 15 | 12 | 0 | 0.556 | 1.000 |
| JET07 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 0 | 0 | 1.000 | 1.000 |
| JET08 | 15 | 19 | 15 | 4 | 0 | 0.789 | 1.000 |
| JET09 | 15 | 26 | 15 | 11 | 0 | 0.577 | 1.000 |
| JET10 | 15 | 24 | 14 | 10 | 1 | 0.583 | 0.933 |
| **Overall** | **151** | **185** | **148** | **37** | **3** | **0.800** | **0.980** |

JET00 is not scored: the generator writes clean records, so there is nothing to
find. Its checks are covered by unit tests with hand-made broken rows.

The false alarms are explainable, and a reviewer would clear them quickly:

- JET06: the monthly rent is exactly 60,000, which is round by nature.
- JET09: the monthly reversal of the utilities accrual contains "reversal".
- JET08: four ordinary payments fall inside the window of an injected split.

Overall the tests reduce 5,706 vouchers to 185 for review, about 3 percent,
while missing 3 of 151 injected anomalies.

### What the log scale is worth

JET10 scored both ways on the same data:

| Scale | Flagged | Caught | False alarms | Precision | Recall |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Raw amounts | 396 | 15 | 381 | 0.038 | 1.000 |
| log(amount) | 24 | 14 | 10 | 0.583 | 0.933 |

Accounting amounts are right-skewed: many small lines and a few large ones. On
the raw scale, large but perfectly normal lines sit far from the median, so the
test flags 396 vouchers to find 15. The log scale removes more than nine tenths
of the false alarms and gives up one catch.

## Project layout

```
src/voucher_analysis/
  generate.py    synthetic ledger, bank statement and ground truth
  loaders.py     read and type-check input files
  jet.py         JET00 to JET10 and the month-end table
  reconcile.py   matching passes and the reconciliation statement
  report.py      the Excel workbook
  evaluate.py    precision and recall against the ground truth
  cli.py         command line
tests/           77 tests, run with pytest
data/sample/     the generated year
config.yaml      every threshold
```

The workbook has a Summary sheet, one sheet per test, MonthEnd, BankRec,
Unmatched, and Evaluation when ground truth is supplied. Formatting follows an
audit workpaper: bold headers, frozen panes, number formats, no colours.

## Limitations

- The `holidays` package does not know Chinese make-up working days (调休), so a
  weekend that is officially a working day is still treated as a weekend.
- JET02 uses a 7 day calendar window. One injected duplicate pair is 9 days
  apart because of the Spring Festival and is therefore missed.
- JET10 misses an amount about 10 times its account median, just under the
  cut-off. Moving the threshold would catch it at the cost of more false alarms.
- The chart of accounts is simplified and does not follow the Chinese
  accounting standards numbering in full.
- The reconciliation runs exact one-to-one matching first. A voucher used there
  is not offered to the group-matching pass, which can leave a group unmatched.
- Thresholds are defaults, not audit judgement. On a real engagement they would
  be set against materiality and the client's processes.

## 中文说明

这是一个凭证测试 (Journal Entry Testing, JET) 工具，包含 11 项规则测试和一套银行对账。
**所有数据都是程序生成的合成数据，不是真实公司数据。**

JET 是审计标准程序，ISA 240 要求审计师测试总账中分录的适当性，因为绕开正常业务流程的
分录是操纵利润的常见手段。用合成数据的原因是：真实账套不能公开，而且合成数据带有
"标准答案"，可以量化每个测试抓到多少、误报多少。

测试覆盖：借贷不平、重复入账、周末与节假日过账、非工作时间录入、关账后补录、整数金额、
职责分离失效 (制单人=审批人)、拆分付款规避审批限额、可疑关键词、金额离群。

银行对账分三步：先一对一精确匹配，再一对多 (一笔银行付款对应多张凭证)，最后把金额接近
但不相等的配成"金额差异"供人工核查。剩下的归类为在途存款、未兑付付款和银行单边项目，
也就是未达账项，并编制双向的银行存款余额调节表，两边调节后余额必须相等。

在样本数据上，5,706 张凭证缩小到 185 张待查，整体 precision 0.800、recall 0.980；
1,850 对银行配对全部正确，调节表两边完全相等。所有阈值都在 `config.yaml` 里。
